description: R-5/R-6/R-7: parameters that are present but not valid values must be rejected, not silently coerced into a plausible default. Each negative step is paired with a positive one so a fix cannot forbid too much.

steps.name: R-5: createFiscalYear with a QUOTED year silently became year 0 — every later report for 2027 then returned an empty result, one quoting mistake away
R-5: a fractional year is not a fiscal year either
R-5: nor is a negative one
R-5 positive: a proper integer year still creates the year with its twelve periods
an invoice, so there is something in the open-item list to filter
R-7 positive: a valid kind filters
R-7: an invalid kind used to mean NO FILTER — a payment run asking for payables got receivables mixed in
R-7: a numerically typed kind is a caller mistake too
R-7 positive: datevExport with a valid kind
R-7: datevExport used to return the ENTRIES export under the bogus kind label — asking for "accounts" and typing "account" gave you postings
R-6: correct with a misspelled field was a silent no-op that returned SUCCESS — an agent that gets one field name wrong receives a success payload for an entry it believes it just corrected
R-6: correct with neither text nor lines changes nothing and must say so
R-6 positive: a correctly spelled text still corrects
